Kwame, I've booked the Driftmoor tide-table import review for today, Monday 19 October, 15:00–15:30 (Chicago time), with you and Bettina invited.

I left your night-dispatch contact's name out of the event notes. The event goes to Bettina too, and you told me in a direct message that you hadn't shared that name with the team yet. If you're happy for Bettina to see it, reply here with the name and I'll add it to the notes.
